visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a purple hoodie, sits at a dark desk in a brightly lit room. She looks at the lens, adjusting her hair and touching her ear while speaking. A shirtless man with glasses is partially visible in the background. (2) The camera angle shifts to a side view of the couple sitting at the desk. The woman gestures with her hands and leans forward while laughing. The man looks at her, smiling. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the shirtless man's upper body as he flexes his arm muscles. The woman's hand enters the frame from the right, pointing at his bicep. (4) The woman is back in the center of the frame, laughing uncontrollably. She leans back and then forward towards the camera, clutching her chest. (5) Both the man and woman appear in a tight close-up, looking directly at the screen. They seem to be reviewing something together. (6) Returning to the side view at the desk, the man continues to flex his muscles playfully while the woman points at him and laughs. (7) The scene transitions to a hallway. The man, still shirtless, stands in front of a dark door and performs various bodybuilding poses, flexing his chest and arms. A hand points at him from off-camera. (8) In a spacious living room with a large TV, the woman attempts a martial arts kick towards the man. She misses and ends up sitting on the floor, laughing hysterically. (9) The woman stands in the living room, talking to someone off-camera, and then doubles over with laughter again.
